title: Set 58

sentences.ko: 솔직히? 예쁘긴 해. 근데 너 그 재킷 이미 있잖아. 네가 맨날 입는 갈색 거, 그거랑 사실상 같은 코트야. 마음에 들면 그냥 입어. 네가 물어봐서 말한 것뿐이야.
sentences.text: Honestly? It looks good, I just think you already have that jacket. Like the brown one you wear all the time, it's basically the same coat. If you love it, keep it, I'm only saying it because you asked me.

alts.text: I mean, it looks good? It's just, you've already got that jacket. That brown one you wear all the time, it's basically the same coat. If you love it, keep it, I'm only saying it cause you asked.

To be honest, it does look good. I simply think you already own that jacket. The brown one you wear constantly is essentially the same coat. If you love it, by all means keep it. I am only mentioning it because you asked me.

sentences.note: **basically the same** 은 세세하게는 달라도 결국 같은 거라는 뜻입니다. **I'm only saying it because you asked me** 는 쓴소리를 한 뒤에 붙이는 말로, 하고 싶어서가 아니라 물어봤으니 답한다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

sentences.ko: 옛날 룸메이트가 나한테 2천 달러만 빌려 달래. 걔가 갚기는 아마 갚을 텐데, 전에 이렇게 빌려준 애는 그 뒤로 연락이 뚝 끊겼거든. 그렇다고 안 된다고 하면 내가 자기를 못 믿는 걸 알아챌 거고, 뭐, 솔직히 못 믿는 것도 맞긴 하고? 오늘 밤에만 폰을 네 번은 들었다 놨는데 아직도 답을 못 했어.
sentences.text: My old roommate asked me to lend him two thousand dollars, and he's probably good for it, but the last guy I did this for I never heard from again. And if I say no he's going to know I don't trust him, which, I mean, I kind of don't? I've picked up my phone like four times tonight and I still haven't answered him.

alts.text: So my old roommate wants me to spot him two thousand dollars, and he'd probably pay me back, but the last guy I did this for totally ghosted me. And if I say no he's gonna know I don't trust him, which, okay, I kinda don't? I've picked up my phone like four times tonight and I still haven't answered him.

My former roommate has asked me to lend him two thousand dollars. He would most likely repay it, but the last person I did this for never contacted me again. If I decline, he will know that I do not trust him, which, I admit, I do not entirely. I have picked up my phone four times this evening and I still have not answered him.

sentences.note: **good for it** 은 그 돈을 갚을 사람이라는 뜻입니다. 캐주얼 쪽의 **spot him** 은 돈을 잠깐 대준다, **ghosted me** 는 아무 말 없이 연락을 끊고 사라졌다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구한테 고민 상담하면서 결론은 못 내리기

sentences.ko: 물 달라고 하더니, 노래 한 곡만 더 하자고 하더니, 그다음엔 옷장에 뭐가 있대. 그래서 캄캄한 데 바닥에 앉아 있었어, 다리에 감각이 없어질 때까지. 내가 일어서는 순간 처음부터 다시 시작할 게 뻔하니까. 지금 아홉 신데 나 아직 아무것도 못 먹었어. 어디 가자는 말 하지 마. 나 이 소파에서 안 일어나.
sentences.text: He wanted water, and then one more song, and then there was something in the closet, so I sat on the floor in the dark until my leg went numb, because the second I stood up he'd start the whole thing over. It's nine and I haven't eaten. Don't ask me to go anywhere, I'm not getting off this couch.

alts.text: First it was water, then one more song, then there was something in the closet, so I sat on the floor in the dark till my leg went numb, cause the second I stood up he'd start the whole thing over. It's nine and I haven't eaten. Don't ask me to go anywhere, I'm not getting off this couch.

He wanted water, and then one more song, and then there was something in the closet, so I sat on the floor in the dark until my leg went numb, because the moment I stood up he would begin the entire routine again. It is nine o'clock and I have not eaten. Please do not ask me to go anywhere. I am not getting off this couch.

sentences.note: **the second I stood up** 의 the second 는 하는 그 순간이라는 뜻입니다. **my leg went numb** 는 다리에 감각이 없어졌다, 즉 다리가 저렸다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 한번은 새벽 다섯 시에 고양이가 문밖에서 울길래 내가 일어나서 밥을 줬거든. 그랬더니 이제 그게 당연한 일이 돼 버렸어. 안 주고 버텨도 봤는데 더 크게 울기만 해. 옆집 사람은 밤에 일하니까 내가 이길 수가 없는 싸움이지. 내가 자초한 거야, 나도 알아.
sentences.text: One time my cat cried outside my door at five in the morning and I got up and fed her, so now that's just how it is. I've tried waiting her out, but she only gets louder, and my neighbor works nights, so I'm never going to win that one. I did this to myself, I know.

alts.text: I fed her once at five in the morning when she was crying at my door, and yeah, that's just the deal now. I've tried waiting her out, but she only gets louder, and my neighbor works nights, so I'm never gonna win that one. I did this to myself, I know.

On one occasion my cat cried outside my door at five in the morning and I got up and fed her, and that is simply how it has been ever since. I have tried waiting her out, but she only becomes louder, and my neighbor works nights, so I will never win that particular battle. I did this to myself, I am aware.

sentences.note: **waiting her out** 은 상대가 포기할 때까지 버틴다는 뜻입니다. **I did this to myself** 는 남 탓할 것 없이 내가 자초했다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 기다렸다가 나랑 같이 본다며. 근데 내가 엄마 집에 가 있는 동안 두 편이나 앞서 봤잖아! 그러니까 안 돼, 오늘 밤에 새로 시작하는 거 없어. 어차피 또 그럴 거잖아. 우리 둘 다 이미 본 걸로 골라. 아니면 나 자러 간다.
sentences.text: You said you'd wait and watch it with me, and then you went two episodes ahead while I was at my mom's! So no, I'm not starting anything new tonight, because you'll just do it again. Pick something we've both already seen or I'm going to bed.

alts.text: Okay but you said you'd wait for me, and then you went two episodes ahead while I was at my mom's! So nope, nothing new tonight, cause you'll just do it again. Pick something we've both already seen or I'm going to bed.

You said that you would wait and watch it with me, and then you went two episodes ahead while I was at my mother's. So no, I am not starting anything new tonight, because you will simply do it again. Please choose something we have both already seen, or I am going to bed.

sentences.note: **two episodes ahead** 는 상대보다 두 편 앞서 봤다는 뜻입니다. **you'll just do it again** 은 어차피 또 그럴 거라는 말로, 앞의 일을 근거로 미리 못 박을 때 씁니다.

reviewed: 1번 한국어: 이미 산 옷 얘기인데 "마음에 들면 그냥 사"라고 되어 있어 keep it 의 뜻과 어긋납니다. "마음에 들면 그냥 입어"로 고쳤습니다.
1번 note: 별표로 감싼 I am only saying it because you asked me 가 문장에는 축약형(I'm only saying it)으로만 나옵니다. 문장에 실제로 나오는 형태로 맞췄습니다.
1번 캐주얼: You've just already got that jacket 은 어순이 어색해 원어민이 이렇게 말하지 않습니다. It's just, you've already got that jacket 으로 고쳤습니다.
4번 캐주얼: text 와 앞부분이 거의 그대로 겹쳐(One time my cat cried... / So my cat cried...) 말투를 바꾼 것이 아니었습니다. 더 짧고 구어체로 다시 썼습니다(that's just the deal now).
5번 캐주얼: Nope. 만 앞에 붙였을 뿐 첫 문장이 text 와 완전히 같았습니다. 앞부분을 다시 쓰고 뒤도 더 줄였습니다(So nope, nothing new tonight).
5번 note: 별표로 감싼 you will just do it again 이 그대로 나오는 문장이 없습니다(text 는 you'll, formal 은 will simply). 문장에 나오는 you'll just do it again 으로 맞췄습니다.
